title: 主网持续套利广播产出：逐环解阻断（只读诊断，第 1-3 环）
authority: read-only; manager API read with GET; store opened with mode=ro; no write, no sign, no broadcast

definition.L1: review reported a positive measured profit expectation
definition.L2: review also carries runArbitrage.ok=true and executable=true
definition.L4: a broadcast attempt row exists with a transaction hash

fourLevelReading.conclusion: L1 and L2 are NOT broadcast output. The mainnet continuous-arbitrage broadcast output is currently 0.

ring1_broadcastSideSwitch.finding: enabled=false is NOT a configuration toggle. It is the absence of the manager_broadcast_library_state row for (network, chain_id, protocol, scope_key). The row is written by upsert_broadcast_state() inside the Broadcast Manager's submit/finalize path.

prerequisites.detail: manager_broadcast_library_state has no row for chain 4663 / core4, so read_broadcast_status() returns the disabled stub (broadcastVersion=0, all counters 0).
the review upstream exists (reviewVersion=22, closedLoopVersion=11, loopCount=44), so read_review_upstream() would NOT fail with MissingReviewState.
manager_v4_review_broadcast_requests is empty (0 rows). A submit has nothing to consume.
the endpoint is exercised only by the Rust unit tests; NO production caller (neither the Python runtime nor the healer) posts to it. The chain L2 -> L3 is therefore not wired end to end.
no authorization exists in the evidence; not assumed and not self-granted.

ring2_reviewSideExecutablePrerequisite.finding: All 44 manager reviews carry the identical reason 'runArbitrage returned ok=false'. That is the branch where the upstream chain evidence says the route was NOT profitable. The single-tick gate and the state-transition gate are NOT the blocker: both only run after run.ok && run.executable is true, and neither was reached.
ring2_reviewSideExecutablePrerequisite.businessConclusion: runArbitrage ok=false is a real on-chain business conclusion (the route was not profitable at measurement time). It is NOT a capacity, identity or gate defect, and it must NOT be recorded as one, nor relaxed to manufacture positive>0.

corroborationFromLegacyLibrary.note: The legacy runtime library DOES contain positive profit expectations (332) and execution-confirmed rows (10). The manager review library is a different record set with its own version and freshness; it is stale (reviewVersion=22, oldest far beyond the 600s freshness window). The two are not interchangeable.

ring2_reviewSideExecutablePrerequisite.verdict: 缺（复核侧无一例可执行；根因为链上不盈利，非缺陷）

ring3_closedLoopIdentityReading.finding: All 44 manager reviews publish NO closed-loop identity at all (the field is absent), because they were materialized BEFORE migration 20261121_014 added the identity columns, and because NO historical backfill is permitted. Absence is UNMEASURED, NOT a mismatch.
ring3_closedLoopIdentityReading.verdict: 未测量（不是不匹配）；需要 TASK-143 的重新物化才能落库

amounts.realizedPnlReason: L4 = 0, so there is no realized P&L, no gas cost, no slippage and no receipt to report.

whatThisDoesNotProve: It does not prove that no profitable opportunity exists on mainnet: the window contains 332 positive profit expectations and 10 execution-confirmed rows in the LEGACY runtime library. The manager review library is stale (reviewVersion=22), and its 44 rows were measured long ago.

It does not prove the broadcast path is broken in code: submit_broadcasts_write() has passing unit tests. What is missing is a PRODUCTION caller of POST /v1/broadcasts/submit, plus the authorization. The code path exists; the wiring does not.

It does not prove the single-tick gate or the state-transition gate would pass: neither was reached, because the route never reached 'run.ok && run.executable'. Their behaviour on a profitable route is still unmeasured on mainnet.
It does not prove any realized profit or loss: L4 = 0. Every amount in this report is a REVIEW-STAGE expectation, never a realized amount.
It does not prove the identity of a review is intact: the identity is UNMEASURED for all 44 rows (absent, not mismatched).
It does not generalize beyond chain 4663 and the 24-hour window named in the environment block.
